        <p>
        I am a research scientist at <a href="https://deepmind.google/" target="_blank">Google DeepMind</a> in London.
        Previously I was a research scientist at <a href="https://sakana.ai" target="_blank">Sakana AI</a>.
        Before that, I completed my PhD in Statistics and Data Science at Yale.
        My current interests include recursive self-improvement and automated scientific discovery.
        </p>
